stem: Which law would be considered unconstitutional on the basis of First Amendment guarantees?

options.label: F
options.text: A ban on the publication of classified information by government employees

options.label: G
options.text: A requirement that church employees pay income tax

options.label: H
options.text: A requirement that churches get a permit before building a new chapel

options.label: J
options.text: A prohibition on electing religious leaders to government office
